restart.contract: Ordinary graceful restart with commit-before-ack; not crash exactly-once

limits: Real local socket connect/accept/orderly-close without application data; not captured native AWS TCP payload parity.
Independent source-namespace header-only AF_PACKET witness supplies counts, actual IP bytes and flags; no count is inferred from socket calls.
TCP payloads, fragments and ambiguous offload segment counts remain capture gaps. This verifies existing TCP-control behavior, not new general TCP support.
TCP acceptance is exercised; existing denied traffic cases are UDP. The separate native receiver fixture also exercises injected RST and ECN controls.
Ordinary graceful controller restart with commit-before-ack; not crash exactly-once or gap-free capture.
Parquet missing numeric nulls and MIME remain tested interoperability choices, not native AWS payload/MIME calibration.
